items.prompt: A yellow Moscow taxi bouncing along a muddy two-rut track through a bare grey November forest of birch and alder, toward a clearing where an ordinary old wooden dacha stands, its windows faintly lit. Seen from behind the car.

alt.ru: Жёлтое такси подпрыгивает по грязной колее через голый ноябрьский лес к поляне, где стоит старая деревянная дача со слабо светящимися окнами.
alt.en: A yellow taxi bouncing along a muddy track through a bare November forest toward a clearing with an old wooden dacha, its windows faintly lit.
alt.pt: Um táxi amarelo aos solavancos num trilho lamacento por uma floresta nua de novembro rumo a uma clareira com uma velha dacha de madeira de janelas ténues.
alt.es: Un taxi amarillo dando tumbos por un camino embarrado en un bosque desnudo de noviembre hacia un claro con una vieja dacha de madera de ventanas tenuemente iluminadas.

items.prompt: The interior of what should be a small wooden dacha, but the hallway inside is impossibly vast: the floorboards stretch into a dim distance, the walls recede and fold like folded paper, a single ordinary door standing open far away. Uncanny but quiet.

alt.ru: Внутри маленькой деревянной дачи невозможно огромная прихожая: половицы уходят в полумрак, стены отступают и складываются, как бумага, вдали открыта одна обычная дверь.
alt.en: Inside a small wooden dacha an impossibly vast hallway: floorboards stretching into dimness, walls receding and folding like paper, one ordinary door open far away.
alt.pt: Dentro de uma pequena dacha de madeira, um vestíbulo impossivelmente vasto: tábuas a perder-se na penumbra, paredes a recuar e dobrar como papel, uma porta comum aberta ao longe.
alt.es: Dentro de una pequeña dacha de madera, un vestíbulo imposiblemente vasto: tablas que se pierden en la penumbra, paredes que retroceden y se pliegan como papel, una puerta corriente abierta a lo lejos.

items.prompt: A long wooden table in a dim room, four people sitting at it with cups of tea in front of them, three women and one man, seen from the doorway and from behind or in shadow; an empty chair at the end waiting for the newcomer.

alt.ru: Длинный деревянный стол в полутёмной комнате: четверо, три женщины и мужчина, сидят над чашками чая; в конце стола ждёт пустой стул.
alt.en: A long wooden table in a dim room: four people, three women and a man, sit over cups of tea; an empty chair waits at the end.
alt.pt: Uma longa mesa de madeira numa sala escura: quatro pessoas, três mulheres e um homem, diante de chávenas de chá; uma cadeira vazia espera na ponta.
alt.es: Una larga mesa de madera en una sala en penumbra: cuatro personas, tres mujeres y un hombre, ante tazas de té; una silla vacía espera al final.
